description: Defines the implementation class for a software lower PHY uplink processor, including configuration, processing states, and integration with PRACH and PUxCH processors within a 3GPP-like radio system.

classes.name: lower_phy_uplink_processor_impl
classes.description: Implementation of a generic lower PHY uplink processor handling PRACH and PUxCH processing, with state management and sample processing.

methods.name: lower_phy_uplink_processor_impl
methods.description: Constructor initializing the processor with PRACH and PUxCH processors and configuration.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Connects the processor with notifier interfaces for PRACH, PUxCH, and uplink processing notifications.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops internal PRACH and PUxCH processors.

methods.name: get_prach_request_handler
methods.description: Returns the request handler for PRACH processing.

methods.name: get_puxch_request_handler
methods.description: Returns the request handler for PUxCH processing.

methods.name: get_baseband
methods.description: Returns reference to the baseband processing component.

methods.name: get_cfo_control
methods.description: Returns reference to the CFO (Carrier Frequency Offset) processor.

methods.name: get_carrier_center_frequency_control
methods.description: Returns reference to the carrier frequency control component.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Main processing function handling incoming baseband samples based on current FSM state.

methods.name: process_alignment
methods.description: Handles sample processing during alignment state to synchronize with subframe boundary.

methods.name: process_symbol_boundary
methods.description: Handles processing at symbol boundaries within a subframe.

methods.name: process_collecting
methods.description: Collects and buffers samples during the collecting state.
